headline: Blue Dart Express reports 28% jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 104 crore
hook: Strong volume growth lifts Blue Dart profit
summary: Blue Dart Express posted a 28.4% increase in net profit to ₹104 crore for the second quarter, up from ₹81 crore in the corresponding period last year. Revenue from operations grew 14.5% to ₹1,774 crore, supported by steady demand. EBITDA for the quarter rose 14.2% to ₹287.4 crore with the EBITDA margin standing at 16.2%. For Indian retail investors, the earnings reflect healthy consumer and B2B logistics volumes during the quarter.
why_it_matters: Earnings beat improves sentiment for listed logistics players.
winners_losers: Blue Dart shareholders gain / competitors neutral
